market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from two Fed hikes, oil above $100, and consumer stress. Dow found support on oil pullback but S&P 8,000 resistance holds. Expect volatility 15-20% ATR. Energy and gold outperform; consumer and long-duration underperform. Bessent's bond market credibility damaged.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and productivity gains support equity recovery by Q1 2027 if inflation peaks. However, trade war fragmentation, housing correction, and energy transition costs (clean investment -17%) create structural headwinds. Fed tightening likely peaks by Q4 2026, enabling re-rating. Geopolitical risk premium persists.
